captions.detailed: This 3D model features two simple, thin, flat cylindrical discs positioned at a distance from one another. Each disc has a smooth circular outer edge and a flat top and bottom surface, representing basic solid cylindrical shapes without any visible holes or connectors between them in the rendered view.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric wrench tool with a central rectangular handle, featuring a closed-end hex wrench head on one side and an open-ended hex wrench head on the other. The design should allow the user to easily adjust parameters such as the nut diameter, nut thickness, handle length, and head clearance size.
captions.factory: The script uses a custom module 'wrench_head' to define the wrench ends by applying a difference operation between a solid cylinder, a rotated hexagon (imported from shapes.scad), and a rectangular box (for the open-ended slot). The final assembly combines these parts by translating a central rectangular handle (using a custom box module) and attaching the closed and open wrench heads at opposite ends along the Y-axis.
